source.name: FrequencyWords — OpenSubtitles 2018
source.attribution: FrequencyWords by Hermit Dave; derived from OPUS OpenSubtitles 2018 and OpenSubtitles.org. Content is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Jenechka Cards extracts the first 1,000 original rows per language and converts them to JSON without changing their order or counts.
source.methodology: Original corpus token counts, not lemma or sense frequencies. rank is the one-based upstream row number. Punctuation, fragments, foreign words, and inflected forms are deliberately retained; nothing is filtered, normalized, lemmatized, or re-ranked here. Chinese uses zh_cn; Portuguese uses pt, not pt_br. These data do not establish CEFR levels or verified translations. A downstream lexicon match must preserve the original rank and report partial coverage instead of relabeling a subset as a complete Top N deck.
source.inputHashScope: Exact first 1000 UTF-8 lines, including LF line endings.
